# glpi_software (Resource)

GLPI software.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "glpi_manufacturer" "vendor" {
  name = "Vendor"
}

resource "glpi_software_category" "productivity" {
  name = "Productivity"
}

resource "glpi_software" "editor" {
  name            = "Editor"
  manufacturer_id = glpi_manufacturer.vendor.id
  category_id     = glpi_software_category.productivity.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the item.

### Optional

- `category_id` (Number) ID of the software category.
- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `entity_id` (Number) ID of the entity that owns the item. 0 is the root entity.
- `helpdesk_visible` (Boolean) Show the software in the helpdesk.
- `location_id` (Number) ID of the location.
- `manufacturer_id` (Number) ID of the publisher.
- `update` (Boolean) The software is an update of another software.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) GLPI numeric ID.
- `valid` (Boolean) Whether the licenses cover the installations, computed by GLPI.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by GLPI numeric ID.
terraform import glpi_software.example 42
```
